Personality: Urundulf, a prominent figure of the Euthydemidai, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Urundulf owes allegiance to the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of Euthydemidai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Euthydemos, head of the Euthydemidai, a Macedonian house of Baktria. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
